# Tynkr Tools & Co — Desktop App Suite

> Five privacy-first desktop apps for Windows from Built by Josh Studio LLC, under its Tynkr Tools & Co brand. Everything lives in ordinary files on your own machine — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions. Buy once, own forever. The suite is in development; visitors can get notified at launch.

Tynkr is the desktop software line from Built by Josh Studio (a one-person creative studio in Kansas, incorporated as Built by Josh Studio LLC in 2026; Tynkr Tools & Co is its productivity brand). Each app stores your work in files on your machine — open them, move them, or back them up yourself. None of the apps send us your data, and there are no accounts, telemetry or analytics. Tynkr Ledger, Vault, Hearth and Forge make no network calls of their own; Tynkr Inkpress makes no network calls of its own except downloading remote images linked by a manuscript during print PDF export (and uses Windows WebView2 and Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome for PDF export). Microsoft handles the purchase, license, and updates through the Microsoft Store. All five apps share the same contract: your files on your machine, one-time purchase, no telemetry, no accounts. The apps are not yet released — the marketing site collects launch notifications (via the Tynkr Tools & Co Substack).

This site (tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com) covers the desktop apps only. The broader Built by Josh Studio catalog — Notion OS templates, Excel/Google Sheets workbooks, guided print planners, zodiac art, books, and the cookbook — lives at builtbyjoshstudio.com (index: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt). Fuller file for this site: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt.

## The apps

- [Tynkr Ledger — Personal Finance OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/): Personal finance on your own disk — transactions, budgets, bills, debt payoff, and net worth. Local-first Windows app; no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
- [Tynkr Vault — Second Brain OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/): Notes in plain Markdown files you own, with tasks and weekly reviews built in, and search that finds a note by its title (typo-tolerant) or by the words inside it. Local-first Windows app; no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
- [Tynkr Hearth — Homebuyer OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/): The whole home purchase mapped — mortgage math, down-payment planning, cash-to-close, roadmap, and document checklist. Local-first Windows app; no cloud, no accounts.
- [Tynkr Forge — Small Business OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/): Inventory, orders and invoicing for a small shop, with no monthly fee. Features, in order: inventory with stock levels and reorder targets, vendors and purchase orders, customer CRM and sales pipeline, proposals, PDF invoices, projects and time tracking, financial dashboard, contracts, expenses with receipts, and reminders. One local-first Windows app — no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
- [Tynkr Inkpress — Book Formatting](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/inkpress/): Turn your manuscript into an EPUB 3 ebook, a print PDF at KDP paperback trim sizes and a web page for your author site. Choose a clean, styled or framed look (Ashveil, Systemfall, Sootline), check live print and ebook previews and preflight checks, and keep your work on your own PC — no account, no telemetry, no subscription.
